Description

Howa Type 64, a rifle that is well known both in media and the JSDF, is chambered in 7.62 Nato rounds. Although it’s supposed to use a modified cartridges with lower gunpowder, locals seems to use regular ones. Oh yeah 30 of them were lost, but i guess that doesn’t matter since it somehow ended up here.

How did this get into a slavic country, like genuinely how, who on gods earth smuggled this here.

Can be bought from Mechanic LL1 (Most of it are in euro or barter)
